title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In this alternate-universe spinoff, Iruma is a poor, kind boy in a slum who gives his last bread to an injured old man, Don Sullivan, head of the Babel Mafia, who then adopts him as his grandson (Kodansha blurb). Nine years later Iruma is the family's underboss, guarded by Opera and tutored by the stern treasurer Kalego (Anime UK News). The cast are demon characters from the main series recast as mafiosi.
life_message: Kindness and loyalty to family can carry a person through even a dangerous world.

content.note: Organized crime, guns and martial arts (AniList, MangaUpdates); review notes a man in a pool of blood and a kidnapping.
Kidnapping for ransom, conspiracy (review, AniList spoiler tags); tone mainly upbeat.
